record.paper_title: Some Open Problems on Locally Finite or Locally Nilpotent Derivations and E-Derivations
record.original_question: Let R be a commutative ring, let A be an R-algebra, and let δ be either an R-derivation of A or an R-E-derivation of A, where an R-E-derivation means an R-linear map of the form I − φ for some R-algebra endomorphism φ of A. For an R-subspace V of A, write r(V) for the set of elements a in A such that a^m lies in V for all sufficiently large m; and say that V is a left, right, or two-sided Mathieu subspace when eventual membership of all powers a^m forces eventual membership of ba^m, a^mc, or ba^mc respectively. The LFNED problem asks for a description of r(δ(I)) for every left, right, or two-sided ideal I of A, asks which R-derivations and R-E-derivations of A have image Im δ = δ(A) that is a Mathieu subspace of the corresponding handedness, and asks which such maps send every left, right, or two-sided ideal I of A to a Mathieu subspace of the corresponding handedness.

evidence.quote: Definition 1.1. Let ϑ represent the words: left, right, or two-sided. An R-subspace V of an R-algebra A is said to be a ϑ-Mathieu subspace (ϑ-MS) of A if for all a, b, c ∈ A with a^m ∈ V for all m ≥ 1, the following conditions hold: 1) ba^m ∈ V for all m ≫ 0, if ϑ = left; 2) a^mc ∈ V for all m ≫ 0, if ϑ = right; 3) ba^mc ∈ V for all m ≫ 0, if ϑ = two-sided.
Definition 1.2. [Z3, p. 247] Let V be an R-subspace of an R-algebra A. We define the radical of V , denoted by r(V ), to be the set of a ∈ A such that a^m ∈ V for all m ≫ 0.

Problem 1.4 (LFNED Problem). Let R be a commutative base ring, A an R-algebra and δ an R-derivation or R-E-derivation of A. A) Find the radical of δ(I) for all one-sided or two sided ideals I of A. B) Decide which R-derivations and R-E-derivations of A have the image being a ϑ-MS of A. C) Decide which R-derivations and R-E-derivations of A map every ϑ-ideal of A to a ϑ-MS of A.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let R be a commutative ring (with identity) and let A be an associative R-algebra. A map δ: A → A is called an R-derivation of A if it is R-linear and satisfies the Leibniz rule δ(ab) = δ(a)b + aδ(b) for all a, b ∈ A. A map δ: A → A is called an R-E-derivation of A if δ = I − φ, where I is the identity map of A and φ is an R-algebra endomorphism of A.

For an R-subspace V of A, define the radical of V by
   r(V) = { a ∈ A : a^m ∈ V for all sufficiently large m }.

Let ϑ stand for one of the words "left", "right", or "two-sided". An R-subspace V of A is called a ϑ-Mathieu subspace (ϑ-MS) of A if for all a, b, c ∈ A with a^m ∈ V for every m ≥ 1, one has:
 (1) ba^m ∈ V for all sufficiently large m, when ϑ = left;
 (2) a^m c ∈ V for all sufficiently large m, when ϑ = right;
 (3) ba^m c ∈ V for all sufficiently large m, when ϑ = two-sided.

Solve the following three problems for every commutative ring R, every R-algebra A, and every map δ that is either an R-derivation or an R-E-derivation of A:

(A) Determine the radical r(δ(I)) for every left, right, or two-sided ideal I of A.

(B) Characterize those R-derivations δ and those R-E-derivations δ of A whose image Im δ = δ(A) is a ϑ-Mathieu subspace of A (for each choice of ϑ ∈ {left, right, two-sided}).

(C) Characterize those R-derivations δ and those R-E-derivations δ of A that map every ϑ-ideal of A to a ϑ-Mathieu subspace of A (for each choice of ϑ ∈ {left, right, two-sided}).
artifact.status_search_result: The LFNED problem is a broad open program posed by Zhao. Several special cases have been resolved: e.g., images of locally finite derivations of k[x,y] in characteristic zero are Mathieu subspaces; images of monomial-preserving derivations and E-derivations of polynomial algebras in characteristic zero have been characterized; and the LFED conjecture is verified for linear K-derivations and linear K-E-derivations of K[x₁,x₂,x₃]. The general problem (arbitrary R, A, δ, and all parts A–C) remains open.

status_evidence.title: Images of locally finite derivations of polynomial algebras in two variables
status_evidence.snippet: The image of any locally finite k-derivation of k[x,y] in characteristic zero is a Mathieu subspace.
status_evidence.claim: A special two-variable case of part (B) for derivations is solved.

status_evidence.title: Monomial preserving derivations and Mathieu-Zhao subspaces
status_evidence.snippet: Complete description of when the image of a monomial preserving derivation or E-derivation of a polynomial algebra is a Mathieu-Zhao subspace; the LFED and LNED conjectures hold for these.
status_evidence.claim: Subclasses of E-derivations have been characterized, partially resolving (B).

status_evidence.title: Mathieu-Zhao spaces of polynomial rings
status_evidence.snippet: Continued investigations into Mathieu-Zhao subspaces of polynomial rings.
status_evidence.claim: Active research on the LFNED program continues; full problem remains open.
